notes.title: VoiceBot 3.9.8 Now Available!
notes.notes:
We're very excited to announce that VoiceBot 3.9.8 is now available for download! This new version of VoiceBot updates it to .NET 8, fixes some issues, and adds some features. Update and try it for free today!

Updating VoiceBot
We encourage everyone to update to this new version today to take advantage of these improvements. If you've already purchased VoiceBot, it's a lifetime license, so you can upgrade to this version at no cost! If you would like to see a complete list of all the changes, please visit the [url=https://www.voicebot.net/ChangeLog/]VoiceBot change log[/url]. We would also like to thank all of the translators who have helped translate VoiceBot to their native languages. Thanks everyone!

notes.title: VoiceBot 3.0 has been Released!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that VoiceBot 3.0 is now [b]available for download[/b]! This free update adds new actions, new features, and new settings, as well as bug fixes and general improvements.


[h1]VoiceBot 3.0 Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the ability to control VoiceBot with a Push to Talk or Push to Ignore HotKey[/*]
[*]New actions: Double Click Mouse Button, Open File, and Toggle Key[/*]
[*]HotKeys can be assigned to individual macros in a profile[/*]
[*]Added support for performing VoiceBot Actions from within Macro Scripts[/*]
[*]Added settings to change Text to Speech speed and volume[/*]
[*]Added an option to start VoiceBot paused[/*]
[*]Added the ability to use command line parameters with Start Program actions[/*]
[*]Updated "Run Macro" actions to allow the use of global macros[/*]
[*]Increased the speed of Type Text actions[/*]
[/list]

We encourage everyone to [b]update to this new version today[/b] to take advantage of these improvements. [b]Your VoiceBot license is a lifetime license, so you can upgrade to this version at no cost![/b]

If you would like to see a complete list of all the changes, please visit the [url=https://www.voicebot.net/ChangeLog/][b]VoiceBot Change Log[/b][/url]. We'd like to send out a big thanks to the dozens of people who helped with the DisplayFusion translations, and the thousands of people that helped test the Beta versions. Thanks everyone!

notes.title: VoiceBot 2.0 Now Available!
notes.notes:
VoiceBot 2.0 is now available for download! This version adds some excellent new features, and fixes a few bugs as well. Important note for existing VoiceBot customers: With the addition of the Global Macros feature, VoiceBot 1.6 and 2.0 settings are not compatible, so sync has been disabled for version 1.6 and lower.

[h1]VoiceBot 2.0 Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a new Global Macros tab in the Settings window, these macros will be recognized regardless of which profile is currently active
[*]Added an online repository for downloading pre-made Macro Scripts
[*]Added a global "Stop Macros" command to cancel all currently running macros
[*]Added KeyDown/KeyUp support in Macro Scripts
[*]Added the ability to add more voices for the "Text-to-Speech" action (in different languages too)
[*]Added the ability to specify multiple phrases for a TTS action, it will randomly choose one each time it runs
[*]Added an action that changes the audio output device
[*]Resolved an issue where the volume control actions didn't work
[*]Increased the maximum hold time on the Press and Release Key action to 999 seconds
[*]Various performance, stability, and bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - VoiceBot
notes.notes:
VoiceBot is Now Available on Steam!

Take command of your games with your voice using VoiceBot! Sending commands to your games and applications is as easy as saying the command out loud. Use your voice to run keyboard shortcuts, click and move your mouse, and even execute complicated macros and scripts.

notes.title: VoiceBot Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
We are very excited to announce that VoiceBot is now [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/374400/]available for purchase on Steam[/url]! VoiceBot Pro on Steam has all of the same features as VoiceBot Pro, but Steam handles the installation and licensing, so you always have it wherever you have your Steam games library. Note that once VoiceBot is installed, Steam does not need to be running for VoiceBot to function.

VoiceBot is regularly $8.99 (USD), but is on for a special Steam launch price of $7.65 (USD)! If you purchase VoiceBot Pro on Steam and enjoy using it, please [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/374400/]review it[/url] to let others know that it's a great buy 

If you've already purchased a VoiceBot Pro Standard license through our website, you can grab a Steam code at no charge through our [url=https://www.voicebot.net/Account/Licenses/]licensing portal[/url].

Thank you, and we hope you enjoy VoiceBot!
